company_name: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
semiconductor_relevance: Low — the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands promotes Dutch high-tech companies but does not directly supply semiconductor products or services.
summary: The Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands facilitates collaboration between Dutch high-tech companies and international partners, particularly in the High-Tech Systems and Materials (HTSM) sector. It supports the promotion of the 'Holland High Tech' brand, which includes notable semiconductor companies like ASML and NXP.

regional_presence.Japan: The Embassy has a long-standing relationship with Japan, fostering scientific and commercial collaboration in the HTSM field.
